name: playgama-developer-cabinet
description: Publish and manage HTML5 games on Playgama from an agent: create games, upload builds and covers, edit in-app products and leaderboards, get QA links, publish a playable sandbox and bring its first players. Its skills check and pack a build, integrate the Bridge SDK and make a trailer of the game.

interface.longDescription:
Publish in minutes, get the audience, start monetization, get all analytics - without leaving your agent.

Playgama hosts HTML5 games. This remote server puts the Playgama developer console behind MCP, so your agent takes a game from a local build to a public link: it creates the game and fills in its form, uploads a build and polls until the engine analysis finishes, uploads covers in the exact sizes the form requires, edits the in-app purchase catalog and leaderboards, returns a QA Tool link, and publishes a sandbox - a public link anyone can play, with no moderation step. It can also bring the first players to that sandbox through Playgama DSP, with banners built from the game's own covers.

Read-only tools are annotated as read-only and every write as destructive, so the client asks first. Submitting a game to moderation, deleting anything, rolling a game back and reading payouts are deliberately left out and stay human actions in the console.

After the link is live the game takes its first players from the Playgama network, and Playgama DSP can send more the same day (beta). Once the game clears the session threshold you can switch on advertising - Playgama Ad serves rewarded, interstitial and banner formats through a single JS SDK. Playtime, retention and revenue reports are in the developer dashboard.

The plugin also brings three skills for the work on your machine. playgama-publish checks the build against Playgama's game checklist, packs the zip and makes the three covers from the game itself. playgama-bridge integrates the Bridge SDK in any engine from Playgama's live documentation. playgama-game-video films the game and makes a trailer or a Short in the game's own look.
capabilities: Create a game and fill in its Playgama form
Upload a build and track engine analysis
Upload covers in the sizes the form requires
Get a QA Tool link for a build or a local game
Publish a public playable sandbox link
Bring the first players to a sandbox via Playgama DSP
Read moderation comments and submission state
Check a build against Playgama's game checklist and pack it
Integrate the Playgama Bridge SDK from its live documentation
Make a trailer or a Short from the game's own gameplay
defaultPrompt: Publish this game to Playgama and give me a public link I can share.
Upload the new build of my game and tell me when the analysis is done.
Show the moderation comments on my game and fix the form.
